sources.description: Standalone full painted rectangle. Older woman, short dark-grey centre/side-parted rolled bob with grey temples, fine separate brows, no glasses/facial hair, gold oval drop earrings. Dark teal-green jacket, wide pale-yellow collar with cream scalloped lace edging, white ribbed inner neckline. Slight screen-left near-frontal serious closed-mouth gaze, upper-bust crop, soft upper-left light/full mottled blue painted background. Tiny earring/lace/thread details unreadable; retain visible groups and compact mascot collar, no invented accessories.

Standalone full painted rectangle. Older woman, dark-grey short rolled curls with grey temple strands/separate brows, no glasses/facial hair, small round gold stud earrings. Navy clothing with broad textured cream lapel bands, small gold oval/round insignia on screen-left lapel, several layered gold bead necklaces including a pale oval pendant at centre. Near-frontal slight screen-left serious closed mouth, upper-bust crop/soft upper-left light/full mottled blue painted background. Tiny badge engraving, bead counts and pendant construction unreadable; preserve actual visible groups.

Standalone full painted rectangle. Older woman, swept-back grey hair in high compact bun, separate brows and distinctive thick black round glasses joined by broad upper bridge. White/cream broad-lapel coat over dark blue tiny pale-spotted blouse with white rounded collar and small gold centre button; partial blue rectangular badge with metallic clip at lower screen right. Slight screen-left serious closed-mouth gaze, upper-bust crop/soft upper-left light/full mottled blue painted background. Badge text/pattern dots/glasses joints unresolved; no invented lettering.

Standalone full painted rectangle. Older woman, swept-back grey hair with low rear bun, separate brows, thin round brown/gold glasses and small gold studs. Black outer clothing with cream textured/lace edge and loosely draped pale-yellow scarf; burgundy clipboard/binder with round metal fastener and inset blue rectangle held into lower screen right. Near-frontal/slight screen-left serious closed mouth, upper-bust crop/soft upper-left light/full mottled blue painted background. Tiny fastener, stud and lace details unreadable; preserve actual binder overlap, no invented text.
